commercial.customerProblem: A team runs a workflow it cannot see clearly — failure points, control gaps, and risk concentration stay invisible until something breaks.
commercial.deliverable: A workflow audit report: per-step risk scores, detected failure points, checkpoint recommendations, and a prioritized risk summary — produced by the verified engine analysis.
commercial.targetCustomer: small ops/consulting teams running undocumented or drifting processes
commercial.priceBasis: Introductory proof-of-machine pricing. Fulfillment is engine-verified compute plus automated delivery QA — near-zero marginal cost. Comparable human workflow audits bill in the hundreds; $49 makes the first transaction easy to approve.
commercial.unitEconomics: one engine analyze call + report render + automated QA — near-zero marginal cost
commercial.marketEvidence: none recorded — internal qualification only; no demand signals scanned
commercial.revenuePath: offer -> checkout -> payment -> job -> checkpoint analyze -> audit report -> delivery QA -> reconcile
commercial.cancellationBehavior: Full refund if the audit cannot be produced.
